title: Shared Screen, Not Solo: Watching as Dialogue
summary: A child learns many times more when they watch with you instead of being left alone in front of the device. Keep the screen in a shared space, not in their room. Watch with them sometimes, and afterward ask, «What did you like? What did you learn?» to turn passive watching into interaction and language.
try_this: This week: Watch a full episode with your child, then discuss it afterward with three simple questions.
reflection_prompts: Where is the device usually located in the home?
How did your child interact when you watched with them?
